title: Montgomery's Large Value Conjecture for Dirichlet Polynomials
exact_target: Can a bounded-coefficient Dirichlet polynomial take very large values at only the conjectured number of well-separated times in every polynomial-length interval?

sources.citation: Larry Guth and James Maynard, New large value estimates for Dirichlet polynomials, Annals of Mathematics 203 (2026), 623-675, Conjecture 1.5.
